tasks.instruction_text: Find an Airbnb in Cleveland for three nights with a budget of $100 to $300 per night. Open the Filters dialog, drag the Price range minimum thumb to $100 and the maximum thumb to $300.
Cap the nightly price at $200 for my Cleveland stay — drag the Price range maximum thumb down to $200, leave the minimum at $0.
I want a Cleveland Airbnb from $100 to $300 per night WITH free parking — set the Price range and check Free parking in the Filters dialog.
I need an Airbnb in Cleveland from $100 to $300 per night, with free parking AND pet-friendly. Drag the Price range thumbs and check both amenities.
Drag the Price range from $100 to $300 per night on the Cleveland Airbnb listings. How many homes match?
Set the Price range from $100 to $300 per night on Cleveland Airbnb. Which listing has the highest guest rating?
I'm upgrading — Cleveland Airbnb from $300 to $500 per night, with free parking. Set the Price range minimum to $300, maximum to $500, then check Free parking.
Cap my Cleveland Airbnb at $100 per night — drag the Price range maximum thumb down to $100 (leave the min alone).
Drag the Price range from $150 to $250 per night. What's the cheapest Cleveland stay in that band and how much per night?
We're bringing our pet — set the Price range from $100 to $300 per night AND check Pets allowed in Cleveland. How many homes meet all three filters?
